inputs.text: Original finely textured pixel painting for a warm early 1990s settlement simulation. Top down flat tileable material sample, small natural texture, even diffuse light, no shadows, no objects, no border, no perspective, fills the whole image. Dark damp umber soil, fine compact silt and softly mottled earth texture. Muted brown and olive undertones. No plants, no pebbles, no standing water.
